title: Worker byte vector append
summary: Recover thiscall append at 0x5c20e0: classify the source against the live range, preserve an internal offset across the external growth helper, copy one byte when the destination is nonnull, and advance the end. The caller at 0x5c1de6 appends a zero byte before consuming the vector buffer.
test_description: Direct original comparisons cover 2400 live lengths and source offsets, including first, last, before and after the live range, plus a null destination. Check full backing buffers, all header pointers, expected appended byte and FS restoration. Source-only controlled relocation tests check internal and external sources and the growth argument.
known_limits: The external thiscall growth helper at 0x519d50 is a required integration dependency; its allocation and error behavior are not recovered or compared against the original.
Original growth paths cannot execute in the trusted oracle without an accepted reference for that helper; controlled growth checks exercise only the recovered caller contract.
The original layout and address arithmetic assume 32-bit pointers; invalid memory accesses, allocation failure and exception paths are not tested.
